summary: Davis, California, cognitive neuroscientist, post-doctoral fellow, expertise in neuroscience of episodic memory, interests in machine learning and cognitive psychology, strong libertarian leanings, advocates for universal basic income, has a family with children, experienced poverty in childhood, engages in discussions about social justice and economic inequality, frequent commenter on topics related to technology and privacy, involved in autism spectrum disorder research, utilizes Linux and programming in research, interested in data analysis and statistical methods.
